 REJURAN® COSMETICS Expands U.S. Retail Presence Through Costco’s First-Ever Beauty Table Program
 Oleh PR NEWSWIRE 
 23 Oktober 2026, 4:07 pm 
 Share on facebook 
 Share on twitter 
 Share on whatsapp 
 Share on email 
 Share on telegram 
 Share on linkedin 
 The premium Korean skincare brand introduces a Costco member set featuring its c-PDRN ® -powered Turnover Ampoule 
 SEOUL, South Korea , Oct. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ — REJURAN ® COSMETICS is expanding its U.S. retail presence through Costco’s new Beauty Table program, bringing its c-PDRN ® skincare to more American shoppers. The premium dermocosmetics brand was developed by PharmaResearch, the biopharmaceutical company behind the globally recognized REJURAN ® skin booster.
 Costco’s Beauty Table display at a Costco warehouse (Photo courtesy of PharmaResearch) 
 Currently operating in 25 U.S. warehouses, the dedicated beauty display program is designed to help Costco members discover beauty brands and products while shopping. REJURAN ® COSMETICS will showcase its brand and key products through the program, with plans to expand its participation to more than 150 U.S. warehouses.
 For the program, the brand is introducing a Costco-exclusive REJURAN ® Turnover Ampoule set, pairing a 50 mL full-size bottle with an additional 10 mL, offering added value for members. Formulated with c-PDRN ® , the company’s proprietary ingredient developed specifically for cosmetic use, the daily skincare ampoule helps hydrate skin and improve texture.
 The launch broadens the brand’s U.S. distribution and makes its products more accessible to both existing customers and shoppers discovering REJURAN ® COSMETICS for the first time. Building on Costco’s membership base and warehouse network, the brand plans to use local consumer feedback and demand to inform future product assortments and marketing initiatives.
 "Costco’s Beauty Table program offers an exciting opportunity to introduce our c-PDRN ® skincare to more U.S. consumers," said Jooyeon Song, Head of Cosmetics at PharmaResearch USA. "We will continue expanding our product offerings and retail presence to reflect the needs of American shoppers and bring the REJURAN ® COSMETICS experience to a wider audience."
 About PharmaResearch and REJURAN ® COSMETICS 
 PharmaResearch is a pioneering South Korean biopharmaceutical company dedicated to enhancing quality of life through regenerative medicine. Its portfolio spans medicines, medical devices, cosmetics and health supplements, built around its core DOT ® PDRN and PN technologies, which are protected by multiple patents. PharmaResearch is headquartered in Gangneung, South Korea.
 The company is behind REJURAN ® , its globally recognized PN-based skin booster available in more than 50 countries, and REJURAN ® COSMETICS, its premium derma-cosmetic brand. Drawing on PharmaResearch’s expertise in PN- and PDRN-based technologies and skin science, REJURAN ® COSMETICS combines proprietary DOT ® c-PDRN ® technology with advanced cosmetic formulations designed to support healthy-looking skin, hydration, and elasticity.
 REJURAN ® COSMETICS continues to expand across major global beauty markets, including North America, as demand grows for science-driven Korean skincare.
 To learn more and shop REJURAN ® COSMETICS, visit rejurancosmetics.com .
